title: Lean beef and root vegetable stew
summary: Lean stewing beef simmered with carrots, celery, mushrooms and new potatoes in a tomato gravy. A pot for four, and it improves if you leave it for ten minutes before serving.

steps.instruction: Pat the beef dry and season it. Warm the oil in the casserole and brown the beef in two batches so it colours rather than steams. Lift it out.
steps.tip: Browning is the flavour. A crowded pan just boils the meat grey.

steps.instruction: Lower the heat, add the onion, carrot and celery and cook for 6 minutes. Stir in the garlic, tomato purée and herbs.
Return the beef with the mushrooms, potatoes, tomatoes, stock cube and water. Cover and simmer gently until the beef is tender and the potatoes are cooked.

Slake the cornflour with a spoon of cold water, stir it in and simmer for 3 minutes until the gravy thickens. Fold in the kale until it wilts. Taste for salt and rest the pot for a couple of minutes before ladling it out.
Share between four warm bowls. The potatoes are in the stew, so you don't need anything else on the plate.
